# Filter rows where the Position is at least in the top five (i.e., 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th)
top_five_positions = ['1st', '2nd', '3rd', '4th', '5th']
top_five_finishes = df[df['Position'].isin(top_five_positions)]
# Count the number of such finishes
count_top_five = len(top_five_finishes)
# Determine the highest (best) finish among these top-five finishes
# Convert Position to a numeric rank for ranking (lower number is better)
rank_mapping = {'1st': 1, '2nd': 2, '3rd': 3, '4th': 4, '5th': 5}
top_five_finishes['Rank'] = top_five_finishes['Position'].map(rank_mapping)
# Find the best (minimum) rank
best_rank = top_five_finishes['Rank'].min()
# Map back to the original Position string for the answer
best_position = [pos for pos, rank in rank_mapping.items() if rank == best_rank][0]
answer = best_position
